" ) def display_user_profile(fullname: str, biography: str, current_status: str) -> str: """ Render a sanitized user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- fullname : str The user's full name as entered. biography : str A user-provided biography that may contain multiple sentences. current_status : str A brief, current status message. Returns ------- str The profile HTML with all user-supplied data escaped. Raises ------ TypeError If any argument is not a string. """ # Validate input types if not all(isinstance(arg, str) for arg in (fullname, biography, current_status)): raise TypeError("All arguments must be of type str") # Escape user-provided data to prevent XSS safe_name = html.escape(fullname, quote=True) safe_bio = html.escape(biography, quote=True) safe_status = html.escape(current_status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( name=safe_name, bio=safe_bio, status=safe_status )
